messages:
Maria C.: FYI MidSea is asking for a quick pack of SOC2 evidence and DPA clarifications ahead of their renewal next week. Evan wants answers by EOD tomorrow.
Evan (MidSea): Appreciate the heads up, Maria. We just need confirmation on log retention and encryption at rest for embeddings.
Maria C.: Copy. @Jordan S. can you confirm retention for auth + inference logs and KMS key rotation cadence?
Jordan S.: On it — auth logs are retained 13 months in our audit bucket, inference traces are 90 days by default. KMS rotates yearly, manual rotate possible on request.
Alyssa R.: Do we have a one-page mapping for where each evidence piece lives? Legal wants S3 locations + a short note they can attach to the DPA.
Jordan S.: I can paste paths. S3 audit: `s3://redwood-audit/auth-logs/` and `s3://redwood-audit/inference-traces/`. Keys are in our KMS alias `alias/redwood-prod-logs`.
Maria C.: Perfect, @Alyssa can you assemble a one-pager with those paths and a sentence on retention + encryption? I can send to Evan when done.
Alyssa R.: Will do. Quick Q: for embeddings retention — do we surface that in the article docs or should we include a short excerpt here?
Jordan S.: Embeddings are not persisted by default in hosted mode unless customer opts into vector store. For MidSea we have embedding retention turned on (30 days) per their config.
Evan (MidSea): That matches our setup. Could you also confirm whether Dedicated customers can set longer retention for regulatory reasons?
Maria C.: Answer: yes, Dedicated allows custom retention via config, we’ll note that and link to the Dedicated settings page.
Alyssa R.: Drafting the one-pager now. Will include: S3 paths, retention numbers, KMS alias, point of contact (Jordan), and a short note on Dedicated options. ETA 2 hours.
Jordan S.: Also adding a short command snippet to show how to pull logs if they need proof:
```
aws s3 ls s3://redwood-audit/auth-logs/2025-11-*/ --profile redwood-audit
```
Maria C.: Great. After Alyssa shares I’ll do a quick QA then send to Evan + loop in Legal for DPA wording.
Evan (MidSea): Thanks team — that timeline works. If we can get the one-pager and the DPA note before EOD tomorrow that keeps procurement happy. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: Deployment to prod completed (deploy-2025-11-03-18). :white_check_mark:
Maria C.: Small risk note — if they request SOC2 Attestation artifact (full report) we’ll need Legal approval to share redacted copy. Flagging for renewal risk if procurement escalates.
Alyssa R.: Noted. I’ll add a line: "SOC2 attestation available on request; sharing requires legal review."
Jordan S.: Done with KMS cadence and paths in the draft. Ping me if Legal asks for additional crypto details.
Maria C.: Thanks all — I’ll send the packet once Alyssa finishes and cc @Jordan and Legal. Keeping this thread for any follow-ups.
